title: PromptUnit
description: One user prompt turn plus its response window (conventions.md), as CONTENT-FREE per-unit metadata emitted by connectors. Exists so the classifier can label prompt/segment units without touching raw logs (connectors stay the only source-reading layer) and without any content: no prompt text, no code, no paths in the clear. Turn indices are 0-based ordinals over user prompt turns per conventions.md, EXCLUDING task-notification records (matching the ADR-0002 calibration indexing). File identity is salted-hashed; path-derived booleans (is_test_path etc.) are computed connector-side so raw paths never leave the connector. 0.1.1: window.interrupted narrowed to interrupted TOOL RESULTS (plus codex turn_aborted); new window.interrupt_marker carries interruption-marker records separately — segmenter 0.1.0 splits on the former only, matching the ADR-0002 calibration reference behavior.

turn_index.description: 0-based over user prompt turns, task-notifications excluded.

window_ended_at.description: Timestamp of the last record in the response window.

gap_ms_before.description: Wall clock from the last record before this prompt to the prompt — the segmenter's turn_gap input.

window.description: Activity between this prompt and the next prompt turn.

tool_counts.description: Per-tool call counts; MCP prefixes kept.

interrupted.description: Window contained an interrupted tool result (claude) or turn_aborted (codex) — segmenter 0.1.0's interrupt input.

active_ms.description: Turn duration where the log records it.

files_edited.description: One entry per distinct file edited in the window. Identity is salted-hashed; booleans are derived from the raw path connector-side.

top_dir_ref.description: Salted hash of the top-level directory — the segmenter's file_set_jump input.

is_agent_config_path.description: Agent tooling config: .claude/, CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP/settings files.

is_new_file.description: Created in this window (Write to a previously absent file); null when the source can't distinguish.

interrupt_marker.description: Window contained an interruption marker record (claude only; null where the source has no such concept). Candidate segmenter 0.2.0 signal; NOT split on in 0.1.0, matching calibration.
